data.narrative:
QuamCore is a Series A quantum computing company that has raised $35M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 11 peers across quantum computing—3 public companies (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private firms including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

The peer-median method was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the quantum computing sector; only 0 same-stage and 0 adjacent-stage peers met filtering criteria, falling short of the 3-datapoint threshold. Accordingly, analysis relied on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $35M total raised as a valuation proxy, yielding an implied value of $70M.

The triangulation analysis, constrained to a single applicable method, supports a median valuation of $70M, with a reasonable range of $60M to $80M reflecting execution and market timing uncertainty. The primary limitation is narrow peer depth at QuamCore's stage; the broader 8-company quantum computing private comp set contains larger-stage and more mature entities. Key downside risks include extended fundraising timelines and competitive intensity within quantum hardware. Upside scenarios depend on technical milestone achievement and capital availability in the frontier-tech market.
